dataset_name: Illumination at the Moon's South Pole, 2023 to 2030
region: Within 2 degrees of the lunar South Pole; south of 88 degrees south latitude
inputs: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) LOLA global terrain mapping
limitations: This is a modeled sunlight and shadow visualization, not live lunar weather or habitat telemetry.
It does not provide measured oxygen, water, food, crew consumption, or outpost battery values.
All game resource percentages and decision effects remain illustrative gameplay values.
